implementation.initial_load: Normal full upload first; texture-limit or memory failure falls back to admitted visible source rectangle when it is smaller than full image
implementation.ownership: Retain managed source clone only for regional fallback; shared original pixel buffer, no full CPU copy
implementation.interaction: GpuState update_view plans current footprint, reuses containing region, skips offscreen source, otherwise replaces admitted region
implementation.raw: Retained MonotoneCurve reapplied after regional upload; view exposure updated normally
implementation.errors: Failure preserves previous source/texture/region; user-visible status on unavailable region and clear on recovery
implementation.release: Regional CPU source released on successful new whole-image load or switch to native RAW/model
